runs.text: Two bakeries send their bread offer, and only the first one matters. Ana waits for the two offers, one after another; Beto serves whichever arrives first. Who serves first?
It is the difference between awaiting one task after another and using
: the second way serves the first answer ready.
Beto: he serves the first one ready without waiting for the other.

justification.text: With only one answer that matters, waiting for the one that arrives later only adds waiting.

runs.text: Ana: waiting for both is safer.

justification.text: Ana ends up with the first offer too, but only after both have arrived.
Only if the two offers arrive together; in any other case Ana waits too long.
